## Upgrade

- **No migrations.** 3.0.6 doesn't change the database schema, so `hot db migrate` has nothing to apply. See [Upgrading from 3.0.5 to 3.0.6](/docs/migrations#upgrading-from-3-0-5-to-3-0-6).

## Features

- **A deploy tells your app what it cancelled.** Since 3.0.5, activating a build cancels the project's dynamic schedules on its other builds, and the app got no signal. Each time a build goes live, Hot now sends one `hot:deploy:activated` event, with `project`, `build-id` and `cancelled-schedules` in `event.data`. The event is written in the activation's transaction, so it exists exactly when the build went live. It reaches every handler for its type in the environment, so a handler checks `project`. It carries a count, not the cancelled arguments, because those were written for the old program. Each activation that cancels schedules also logs the count. See [Dynamic Schedules and Deploys](/docs/schedules#dynamic-schedules-and-deploys) and [deploy events](/docs/events#deploy-events).
- **Every package has a directory category.** 50 of 114 packages had no approved tag, so the package directory showed them under no filter. Each package now has one, and 13 have two where both browse paths matter. 93 packages get a patch version for this, along with packages that pin them. Their APIs are unchanged.

## Fixes

- **One-time schedules no longer fail the cron sync.** The sync tried to make a cron job from every `@at:` row on the deployed build. Each row failed validation and logged an error on every sync, ending in `sync complete with errors`. These rows were never cron jobs, and the scheduler fires them separately, so the sync now skips them.
- **The `ssh` and `sftp` READMEs state the real minimum.** They said 3.0.4. Both packages need Hot 3.0.5.

## Behaviour changes

- **The approved package tags changed.** `apps`, `compliance`, `public-data` and `web` are new. `payments` is now `finance`. `automation` folds into `web`, and `email` into `messaging`. See [Tags](/docs/packages/manifest#tags).
